name: Universidad EAFIT
body: HSTS, nosniff, a strict Referrer-Policy, a Permissions-Policy, a canonical, and a clear description. But none of the 20 pages analyzed has a <main> element, so screen-reader users can't skip straight to the content.
lesson: Wrap the primary content of every template in one <main> for skip links.
summary: www.eafit.edu.co scores 75 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 23 are at risk, and 19 pass. Fix first: 22 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 22 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /sistema-ciencia-tecnologia-innovacion/universidad-ninos, /sostenibilidad, /pregrados and 7 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 6 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /institucional/pei, /sostenibilidad, /pregrados, /posgrados and 2 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: Core Web Vitals fail for real visitors
fix.evidence: Real Chrome users over the last 28 days on this page, at the 75th percentile: Largest Contentful Paint 5.0 s (poor), Interaction to Next Paint 319 ms (needs improvement), Cumulative Layout Shift 0.06 (good). Source: Chrome UX Report through PageSpeed Insights.
fix.fix: Make the largest element arrive sooner: preload the hero image, serve it at the shown size in a modern format, and cut render-blocking scripts. Break up long JavaScript tasks behind clicks and taps, and defer…

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Language alternates point at each other
